column1: # Чем получено: value-coercion sites in rule-option classes and in the option
#   Scan: scratchpad script enum-sources/scan_coercions.py, whose scope and regexes are:
#   scope = { every src/**/*Options.php whose text mentions RuleOptionsInterface or
#   lines whose trimmed form starts with '*' or '//' are dropped (docblock/comment)
#   class/method context = last matching `class X` / `function y` line above the site
#   key column = literal string subscripts of $config/$options/$merged/$value/$raw/
#                $thresholds/$userConfig on the same line, plus RuleOptionKey::* constants
#   - Coercion by typed constructor/parameter signature. With declare(strict_types=1) those
#     REJECT rather than coerce, so they are a different mechanism, not a missed site — but
#     they are also not listed, so this file is not the inventory of "where a value's type
#   - Defaulting written as `?? default` without a cast (that is substitution, not coercion;
#     it IS counted whenever a cast wraps it, e.g. `(bool) ($config[X] ?? true)`).
#     `match(true)` dispatch, and casts written inside a closure passed to array_map —
#     the closure body is attributed to the enclosing method, and a cast split across two
#     physical lines is missed entirely (line-oriented regex).
#   - Type reshaping without a cast operator: RuleOptionsFactory::normalizeScalarConfig()
#     (:252) turns a scalar `false` into an array, expandDotNotation() (:298) turns a flat
#     dotted key into nesting, normalizeKeys() (:277) folds separators. None of these
#     matches a cast regex, and all three change what fromArray() receives.
#   - Anything outside the 58-file scope: collectors, rules themselves, the YAML loader
#   - The scope predicate is a text mention, not a resolved `implements`. A file mentioning
#     an interface only in a docblock would be pulled in (none observed); a rule-option
#     class named other than *Options.php would be missed.
#   by method: fromArray 135 | withOverride 53 | getSeverity 7 | validateNumericFields 4
#              normalizeValue 3 | withVoOverride 2 | 10 further methods with 1 each
#   (getSeverity sites coerce the measured METRIC value, not a config value — 7 of the 214)
#   5 of the 58 scope files carry no coercion site at all:
#   ThresholdParser being one of them is load-bearing: parse() returns the raw config value
#   untouched (:77-82), so a `threshold` value is cast NOT once centrally but at each of
#   which is where most of the 112 (int) sites come from.
